description: A lightweight operating protocol for running serious projects across multiple AI sessions/agents and humans: layered battle map, three ledgers of record, an append-only alignment board with milestone heartbeats, a relay note for cross-session handover, plus quality-judge gates before any external publish. Triggers: start a new project, multi-session collaboration, project ops, mechanism/handbook, alignment, wrap-up, retrospective, operating model.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent apply safe operational sequencing and rollback awareness?
Did the agent verify final system state with concrete evidence?
